TypeScript reference for @azure/search-documents: authentication with DefaultAzureCredential, index creation, document upload, full-text, vector, hybrid and semantic search, facets, autocomplete and batch operations.

Medium only because SKILL.md:18 (repeated at semantic-ranking.md:12 and vector-search.md:12) tells the agent to run `npm install @azure/search-documents @azure/identity`; these are Microsoft's official npm packages, so this is acceptable. Otherwise the content shapes the user's own code, which calls the user's Azure AI Search service with credentials from environment variables.

Sample code mutates search indexes (createOrUpdateIndex, uploadDocuments, batch delete actions) only when the user runs it. vector-search.md:383 builds an OData filter by string interpolation; users should sanitize input in production. The description mentions agentic retrieval/knowledge bases, which the files do not actually cover.
